William Loison, a 27-year-old from Paris, is coaching the Shepparton Blasters. Despite a language barrier, he uses Duolingo to learn English and focuses on the universal language of soccer to train his players.

The Poison:
The region lacks enough qualified coaches, highlighting a systemic gap in sports development that one dedicated individual cannot fully solve.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here. The WHO, WHAT, and WHY are aligned. The coach is using the tools available to solve a communication problem.

This is a 'Smart Altruistic Loop'. The coach shares a goal (team success), uses transparency (admitting the language barrier), and fosters buy-in through active empathy and hard work.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. The positive Will force is high and aligned with the outcome.

The Unavoidable Truth: Language barriers can be overcome with consistent effort and shared passion.

The Unavoidable Lie: A single app can replace the need for systemic investment in regional coaching.
